ambiguity: The statement's hypothesis is θ1 >= θ2, but the proof differentiates under the opposite hypothesis 'If θ2 ≥ θ1, d/dx ln(fx(x)/fy(x)) ≤ 0' — printed verbatim. The proof line ends with the literal text 'is (CHECK!!!) in x' — an editorial placeholder left in the published PDF; the monotonicity direction word (decreasing/increasing) is missing. 'hence X ≤lr Y' is printed twice in the conclusion. Section 3.12 preamble defines the stochastic order as '(X ≤st Y ) if FY (x) ≥ FY (x) ∀x' with FY on both sides, apparently a typo for FX (x) ≥ FY (x).
